toolchain: bs-recomp (own SH-4 to C++20 static recompiler)
approach: Static recompilation of the SH-4 executable to C++20, with the Dreamcast subsystems replaced one by one by native PC implementations, each validated against the original game running in Flycast.
help: Testing full playthroughs on different PCs and controllers
notes: Runs on Windows from the user's own disc (CDI image of NTSC-U T13001N V1.000; the executable inside is checked by SHA-256). Native file system, timing, controls (keyboard, Xbox controller), saves and movies are done; native audio (effects, voices, Manatee music, AICA DSP) is in final validation. Next: Vulkan renderer, removal of the emulated console layer, Linux. No game data is included.
